draftPromotion.absentRequiredChecksNotApplicable (default [merge-gate]) that
has NO run on the head is not applicable. An existing run is still judged.

commits.messageHeadline: conflict watch: a same-line statute conflict goes to a fixer first, n…
commits.messageBody:
…ot a stand-down (live #5017)

New cascade setting conflictWatch.sameLineConflict = fixer | stand-down
(default fixer). With fixer, the watch posts the conflict as a review:changes
finding (merge main, keep both sides' intent, stand down only if a hunk is a
true either/or) instead of a watcher stand-down, and supersedes an existing
watcher stand-down on an already-labelled conflicting PR (any review label but
review:human, which keeps its own recheck). The downstream fix dispatch keeps
its Codex-first / Claude-fallback and round cap. stand-down keeps old behaviour.
